title: Docking and molecular dynamics simulations of ORPphilins targeting OSBP.
authors: Grimanelli, Zoe; Mesmin, Bruno; Gautier, Romain
one_liner_zh: 该文用对接和分子动力学模拟研究ORPphilins与OSBP蛋白的脂质结合域互作，对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA，与本课题无关。
abstract: Oxysterol-bind protein (OSBP) mediates cholesterol/phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate (PI4P) exchange between subcellular compartments, thereby contributing to numerous cellular processes and being linked to several diseases such as cancer and viral infections. Its lipid transfer activity relies on the ORD domain, which forms a hydrophobic pocket enabling binding of sterols and PI4P. Natural compounds from the ORPphilin family have emerged as promising antiviral agents, by targeting the OSBP ORD. However, their functioning at the molecular level remains poorly documented. In this chapter, we detail molecular modelling approaches that offer a valuable tool for exploring these interactions, as they provide dynamic insights into proteinligand complexes not captured by crystallography alone, while being much faster to obtain. With docking and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations methods, one can predict ORPphilin orientations within the ORD pocket, visualize the complexes, and identify specific binding residues, which could serve as basis for designing mutagenesis experiments. MD simulations can further reveal differences in binding energies among ORPphilins, thereby providing mechanistic insights and rationalization of experimental observations.
abstract_zh: 氧甾醇结合蛋白（OSBP）介导胆固醇/磷脂酰肌醇-4-磷酸（PI4P）在亚细胞区室间的交换，从而参与众多细胞过程，并与多种疾病如癌症和病毒感染相关联。其脂质转移活性依赖于ORD结构域，该结构域形成一个疏水口袋，能够结合甾醇和PI4P。来自ORPphilin家族的天然化合物通过靶向OSBP ORD，已成为有前景的抗病毒药物。然而，它们在分子水平上的作用机制仍鲜有记录。在本章中，我们详述了分子建模方法，这些方法为探索这些相互作用提供了宝贵工具，因为它们能提供仅靠晶体学无法捕获的蛋白质-配体复合物的动态见解，且获取速度更快。通过对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟方法，可以预测ORPphilin在ORD口袋内的取向，可视化复合物，并识别特定的结合残基，这可为设计诱变实验奠定基础。MD模拟还能进一步揭示不同ORPphilin之间结合能的差异，从而提供机制性见解并合理化实验观察结果。
